provenance.fixture_recipe: Deterministic synthetic wide universe (P35 wide-universe recipe). BTC prices from tests/fixtures/wide_bab_universe.csv. Asset returns = beta * BTC_return + idio, idio ~ N(0, 0.003), betas linspace(0.35, 1.9, 40). Walk-forward: train=90d, test=30d, step=30d. Not real market data; not market profitability evidence.

walk_forward_stability.description: Spearman rank correlation between in-sample beta ranks (rolling-OLS at the rebalance point) and out-of-sample realized beta ranks (simple OLS over the test window). Measures whether the beta signal persists out of sample.
